sentences.text:
This is fifth bail application filed under section 483 of the BNSS, 2023 for grant of temporary bail in connection with Crime No.533/2023 registered at Police Station - Rajgarh, District - Rajgarh(M.P.)
for offence punishable under Sections 498A, 304-B, 306 and 34 of IPC.
She is in custody since 13.07.2023.

The first and second bail application of the applicant have been dismissed on m e r i t s vide orders dated 20.12.2023 and 31.07.2024, passed in M.Cr.C. No.50612/2023 and M.Cr.C. No.21791/2024 respectively.

Her third bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 14.05.2025,
passed in M.Cr.C. No.20500/2025.
Thereafter, her fourth application for temporary bail was allowed on 08.10.2025, passed in M.Cr.C. No.44899/2025 on the ground of death of her husband.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the present application for grant of temporary bail has been filed on the ground of ill-health of the applicant.
The Medical Officer, Rajgarh has reported that the applicant is continuously NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:3767 2 MCRC-56930-2025 under treatment.
She was referred to District Hospital Rajgarh and Hamidiya Hospital, Bhopal on many occasions Applicant requires continuous medical treatment.

Therefore,
applicant be extended temporary bail.

sentences.text: Learned Counsel for State referred to the report dated 31.01.2026 constituted by the CMO of Rajgarh in furtherance of order dated 13.01.2026.
As the per the said report, the applicant is suffering from severe ailment and was examined by the medical board.
The Medical Board opined that applicant Reshambai is suffering from Blister problem and requires medical examination 2D ECHO (Two-Dimensional Echocardiogram), TMT, Colonoscopy, Endoscopy etc.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Considering the aforesaid, the present application for temporary bail is allowed and it is hereby directed that subject to deposit of cash amount of Rs.50,000/- in the trial Court, the applicant shall be released on temporary bail for a period of 15 days from the date of her release to undergo medical tests and treatment, on her furnishing personal bond of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned.
The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated u/S 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
In case of failure to comply the order within 03 days or violation of condition of bail, this bail order shall automatically stand cancelled.
The applicant shall surrender before the trial Court on or before expiry of period of 15 days.
The cash amount be returned to the applicant on surrender, else it will be forfeited.
Necessary papers regarding surrender of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:3767 3 MCRC-56930-2025 the applicant and her medical tests and treatment be furnished to this Court.
M.Cr.C. stands disposed of accordingly.
C.C. as per rules.

(SANJEEV S KALGAONKAR) JUDGE pn Resham Bai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136459539/
